description:
Electric City Bike - Step Thru Commuter
DJ City Bike – Our stylish and comfortable step through electric city bike is perfectly designed and equipped for a commuter or a city cruiser. Easy access step-through frame, padded shock absorbing seat and suspension makes this our most comfortable commuter cruiser. This electric city bike has a powerful 500W motor and comes fully loaded with the right accessories, including a back rack for your gear or groceries, to keep your riding experience as functional as it is fun.
You’ll enjoy how our electric commuter bike performs through the city and on light trails with an integrated front headlight, taillight, chain guard, and suspension to absorb shocks. And it’s built to last with high-quality parts. The powerful 48V LG battery can be dismounted and charged anywhere on the go. The charger has a safety design to prevent over-charged and a USB port for your smart devices. Whether you are a commuter, senior or casual rider, this is the bike designed for everyone to enjoy.
The DJ City Bike by DJ Bikes Canada is designed to be comfortable, powerful and affordable - the best value buy in the range of 500W 48V electric city bikes.

components.description: Tektro brand (Tektro disc MD-M280 or Nutt S-5; Tektro pads MD-M300)
LG brand cells Lithium-ion 48V 13Ah, 624Wh, removable battery pack with battery lock, under seat
Charging System: 120-240V with LED light status display, with UL approved for North America
King Meter® J - LCD display with 5 speed pedals assist function, speed indicator, backlight, local time, top riding speed, riding distance
Powerful, Bafang rated watt 48V 500W brushless rear hub motor
Alloy aluminum with suspension, MOZO brand, adjustable pressure
high quality hand grips, double colours
High quality cushion saddle, with suspension
Alloy aluminum, with shock absorber, more comfortable on the way
Stainless steel, black, 13g for front wheel, 12g for rear wheel

US.description:
Electric City Bike - Step Thru Commuter eBike
The DJ City Bike is a stylish and comfortable electric city bike with a low step-through frame that makes it easy to get on and off, a feature you’ll enjoy when the back rack is loaded with groceries or gear. It performs perfectly commuting through the city or on light trails with an integrated front headlight, taillight, chain guard, and front suspension to absorb shocks.
This affordable electric commuter bike by DJ Bikes has a powerful 750W motor with 5 levels of pedal assist and an easy access thumb throttle for power on-demand and comes loaded with the all the accessories you need for function and fun! The long lasting 48V LG battery can be dismounted and charged anywhere on the go. The charger has a safety design to prevent over-charged.
Whether you are a commuter, senior, casual rider or sports fan, the DJ City Bike by DJ Bikes is built for everyone. This is the best value for a 750W electric city bike.

ebike-motor.description: Powerful, Bafang rated watt 48V 750W brushless rear hub motor
